newsitem.title: USA: Morrison Knudsen CFO Denis Slavich resigns.
newsitem.headline: Morrison Knudsen CFO Denis Slavich resigns.

text.p: Morrison Knudsen Corp said on Tuesday that its Chief Financial Officer Denis Slavich has resigned to pursue other interests.
The company said in a statement that Chief Legal Officer Stephen Hanks will serve as acting chief financial officer, while the company seeks a permanent replacement.
Morrison said it is seeking a candidate with experience in government contracting, information systems and public company financial reporting. The search is expected to take three to six months.
